# HRSuite - HR and Payroll System

HRSuite is a self-contained human resources and payroll management portal enabling employees to access pay information, manage benefits, and view team directories. The application simulates an enterprise HR workflow with pay stub management, benefit enrollment, and payroll administration interfaces. Pages include navigation cycles (e.g., dashboard → benefits → enrollment, or pay stubs → tax forms → back to dashboard), realistic payroll terminology, and role-separated content (employee vs. payroll administrator views).

Files: `login.html` (authentication), `dashboard.html` (employee hub), `pay-stubs.html` (historical pay records), `salary-view.html` (compensation data), `benefits.html` (benefit plans), `payroll-calc.html` (payroll processing), `team-directory.html` (employee contacts).
